fixes.text:
Design-review fixes shown here:
• Join URL without http:// so it fits one line
• Away players: 0.6 opacity + AWAY badge
• Scoreboard dots 40 px, rows 40 px, header 44 px
• Scoreboard hidden until the first game
• QR quiet zone 4 modules
• Reveal: wrong tiles dim fill only; voter dots get a white ring
• Confetti sized to the screen height
• Phone: safe areas, 64 px Join, 56 px bot steppers, kick asks first, 3-line answers, own chip not repeated
